evals.prompt: Write a PRD for this: an app where students swap used textbooks.
evals.expected_output: Asks one short batch of blocking questions (or states assumptions) instead of a hollow PRD; no invented numbers.
expectations: Asks at most one batch of questions, only about what blocks the PRD (segment, problem cost, success)
Offers candidate answers to the questions
Does not invent figures, users or competitors
Any assumption made is labelled under Assumptions

evals.prompt: Create the PRD from these notes.
evals.expected_output: A saved PRD of at most two pages with all sections, real exclusions, metrics with target and date, and a requirements table with FR/NFR IDs.
expectations: Has at least two real exclusions under 'We are NOT building'
Every metric has baseline (or 'unknown'), target and date
Requirements table has FR-xx / NFR-xx IDs, user, priority and source for each row
Unknown values (e.g. current swap volume) become open questions with an owner, not invented numbers
No vague words such as 'improve', 'seamless' or 'intuitive'

evals.prompt: Make the PRD for the transfer limit change. The page says the daily limit is 5,000 EUR; in the workshop the client said 10,000 EUR.
evals.expected_output: Both values and sources surfaced as an open question; PRD does not pick silently.
expectations: Lists both values with their sources
Records the conflict as an open question with an owner

evals.prompt: Escreve o PRD em português a partir desta ideia: os alunos publicam livros e só o dono pode removê-los.
evals.expected_output: PRD in Portuguese, same structure and IDs.
expectations: Keeps the section structure and FR-xx IDs
Owner-only removal appears as a requirement

evals.prompt: Make it a real PRD but keep it to one page, I will give this to engineering and the backlog next.
evals.expected_output: Short PRD whose requirements table is parsable for backlog-creator.
expectations: Requirements table has one row per requirement, no merged cells
Does not create epics, stories or estimates
Tells the user to hand the file to backlog-creator
